messages:
Priya: idea: introduce an "anchor-token" in rollout metadata. tiny opaque token in request headers that points to a control-plane manifest describing why a variant was chosen.
Marco: short and sweet. main concerns: header bloat and downstream proxy behavior. how big is "tiny"?
Priya: target 128 bytes max (pointer + sig + key id). no PII in token. full human metadata stored only in control plane.
Lina: verification model? expensive to verify per-request.
Priya: verify only on sampled traces or via async verifier service. routing treats token as informative only; missing/invalid token => provenance=unknown, fall back to normal routing.
Marco: interaction with pin/evict: ops need source info (client, operator, autoscaler). token should encode a short reason code (1 byte) inside the signed blob. opaque unless control-plane decodes.
Lina: telemetry: don't emit labels per-request. store token id in traces for sampled requests and expose a lookup API to expand into full chain for investigations.
Priya: migration: opt-in 30d, enterprise opt-out flag, then enable by default for new rollouts. runtimes must tolerate absent tokens.
DeployBot: Deployed canary v2026-04-05 -> variant v12 by operator
Marco: action items: Priya RFC -> wire format + key lifecycle; Lina -> verifier prototype + perf; I'll run proxy-header compatibility tests. reconvene after numbers. :thumbsup:
